name: Control Chart
description: SPC control charts for process stability
whenToUse: Monitor a process over time with Shewhart limits: I-MR for single values, X̄-R or X̄-S for subgroups, with Nelson rules, stages, annotations and frozen Phase II limits.
baselineHint: Empty = use all values as baseline
stagesHint: Number of the last point of each stage — each stage gets its own limits and is judged by them. Empty = single baseline.
stagesSplitSubgroup: Boundary {stages} lies inside a subgroup of {n} — that subgroup is counted in the earlier stage. Use multiples of {n}.
phase2Hint: Phase II locks the current limits and checks new data against them. Only available without stages.
phase2_needsData: Load data first, then freeze the limits.
phase2_noStages: Not available in stage mode — clear stages or thaw first.
phase2_columnChanged: Different column selected — frozen limits discarded, Phase I recomputes.
annotationExcludeHint: Excluded points stay on the chart but no longer influence UCL/LCL. Does not apply with multiple stages or frozen limits.
specHint: For Cp/Cpk calculation. Shown as lines on the chart.
secondaryRulesHint: On the MR, R and S chart only tests 1–4 apply; tests 5–8 check the individuals or X̄ chart only.
noViolations: No rule violations — process is stable.

invariants.subgroupRange: The subgroup size must fit the chart type: 1 for I-MR, 2 to 10 for X̄-R, 2 to 25 for X̄-S.
invariants.chartKeys: Settings exist only for the subcharts I, MR, X̄, R and S.
